- **the home side moneyline (-165, LowVig.ag)** -- [44faa9639a3a54e8] event=a44be11545d471429fd459d4c5740006 selection_id=9e8d61f45a38abf0 edge_bps=None p_model_provenance=none grade=A
  - because: Backing the home side of the moneyline because 2 pre-registered signals fired: (1) the opposing starter's career ground-ball share (starter_groundball_share; each side's number describes the matchup that side's own lineup faces): away 47.0%, home 34.6% (this game's own values rest on: away over 956 batted balls; home over 1,289 batted balls); a gap of 12.4 percentage points, clearing the threshold of 11.6 percentage points (rung 2 of 3, the 75th percentile of that gap over the ladder's derivation sample, 3,516 games with both sides measured, 2023-24). This mechanism's direction was frozen before any search ran at -1 (the side holding more of it is the side the mechanism harms), so the signal points to the home side. Pre-registered reason it should matter: a career ground-ball starter takes the air out of an offence that lives on balls in the air, so the lineup facing the higher ground-ball share is the disadvantaged side and club-level pricing averages the collision out. (2) how far the opposing starter's fastball sits above league pace (starter_velocity_gap; each side's number describes the matchup that side's own lineup faces): away 1.49 mph, home -0.48 mph (this game's own values rest on: away over 267 measured fastballs; home over 183 measured fastballs); a gap of 1.97 mph, clearing the threshold of 1.96 mph (rung 1 of 3, the 50th percentile of that gap over the ladder's derivation sample, 3,149 games with both sides measured, 2023-24). This mechanism's direction was frozen before any search ran at -1 (the side holding more of it is the side the mechanism harms), so the signal points to the home side. Pre-registered reason it should matter: a starter whose fastball sits above league pace is holding stuff the season line has not caught up to, so the lineup facing the harder thrower is the disadvantaged side; velocity leads results and the market prices results. - **Boston Red Sox (home) moneyline (+108, BetUS)** -- [44faa9639a3a54e8] event=c1c95aa0c77e6735bae6602eec2b42be selection_id=9e8d61f45a38abf0 edge_bps=None p_model_provenance=none grade=A
  - because: Backing the home side of the moneyline because 1 pre-registered signal fired: (1) how far the opposing starter's fastball sits above league pace (starter_velocity_gap; each side's number describes the matchup that side's own lineup faces): away 1.92 mph, home -1.42 mph (this game's own values rest on: away over 186 measured fastballs; home over 239 measured fastballs); a gap of 3.34 mph, clearing the threshold of 1.96 mph (rung 1 of 3, the 50th percentile of that gap over the ladder's derivation sample, 3,149 games with both sides measured, 2023-24).   - because: Backing the away side of the moneyline because 1 pre-registered signal fired: (1) the share of the posted lineup holding the platoon advantage over the starter it faces (lineup_platoon_share; each side's number describes the matchup that side's own lineup faces): away 55.6%, home 33.3% (this game's own values rest on: away over 9 lineup slots; home over 9 lineup slots); a gap of 22.3 percentage points, clearing the threshold of 22.2 percentage points (rung 1 of 3, the 50th percentile of that gap over the ladder's derivation sample, 4,856 games with both sides measured, 2023-24). This mechanism's direction was frozen before any search ran at +1 (the side holding more of it is the side the mechanism favours), so the signal points to the away side. Pre-registered reason it should matter: the classic exploitation: a lineup posted one-handed against a starter it holds the platoon advantage over gets more of its plate appearances in the favourable split than the club-level season line the market prices ever reflects. This is a signal count, not a forecast: it publishes no probability of its own, says nothing about whether the market's price is mistaken, and attaches no claim of value -- none has been earned. (Strategy: evolab genome 4703ed67882a9d2b.)
